issues: Assumed 'safety vests' means high-visibility/reflective vests worn on the torso.
Assumed a fixed camera over a work area such as a warehouse or construction site; any person in view is treated as a worker.
summary: Detect people in camera view and flag those not wearing a high-visibility safety vest.

classes.name: person_with_vest
classes.description: A person whose torso is covered by a visible high-visibility safety vest.

classes.name: person_without_vest
classes.description: A person with no safety vest visible on their torso.

event_rules.description: Alert when a person without a safety vest is detected for several consecutive frames.

visual_conditions: Bright daylight and dim indoor/night lighting
Workers near and far from the camera
Front, side and back views of workers
Partial occlusion by shelves, machinery, pallets or other workers
Vests in different colors (yellow, orange, green)
Workers wearing similarly colored clothing that is not a vest
Workers carrying objects that cover the torso
Multiple workers in the same frame, mixed compliance
test_scenarios: Separate recording session with different workers, some with and some without vests
Different camera angle or height than the training footage
Crowded scene with several workers at varying distances
Workers in yellow/orange shirts without vests (hard negatives)
synthetic_targets: Workers at far distance (small in frame)
Rain or dust haze for outdoor sites
